Note 4 - Debt

The Company will remain in compliance with all financial covenants under the credit agreement through the maturity date of the facility.

The outstanding balance of the term loan was $4.1 billion in 2024 and bears interest at a variable rate set by reference to market indices.

Interest on the revolving facility is payable quarterly in arrears under the terms of the credit agreement.

The Company recognizes debt issuance costs as a reduction of the carrying amount and amortizes them over the term of the related borrowing.

Principal repayments are scheduled in equal quarterly installments beginning after the initial draw period ends.

Debt policy: the Company classifies borrowings as current when repayment is due within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

Note 3 - Revenue

The Company recognizes revenue when control of the promised goods transfers to the customer in an amount reflecting the consideration expected.

Note 9 - Segment Information

The Company reports one segment and the chief operating decision maker reviews consolidated results to allocate resources and assess performance.
